title: Moving work between tools and checking exports

sections.skill: Check files after moving them between tools

questions.prompt: What can happen with an unsupported file type?

choices.text: It always opens perfectly and keeps every feature, image and formula exactly the same
It may not open or may lose features

questions.correct_answer: It may not open or may lose features
questions.intro: Work often moves between tools: text drafted in a chat goes into a document, a table goes into a spreadsheet, slides go into a presentation app. Each move can break things. An UNSUPPORTED FILE TYPE may not open or may lose features. An EXPORT may drop images, fonts or formulas. A chat may describe a file ("here is your presentation") when it has only written text, because creating a real file is a separate feature that not every product has. After moving or exporting, OPEN THE RESULT in the program where it will be used and check content, formatting and anything that must work, such as links or formulas.

sections.skill: Compare moving files with moving house

questions.prompt: What can happen to a lamp in a move?

choices.text: It always arrives in better condition than before it was packed into the truck
It can arrive without its shade

questions.correct_answer: It can arrive without its shade
questions.intro: When you move to a new house, things can break in the truck. A lamp may arrive without its shade, a table may not fit through the new door, and a box labeled "kitchen" may hold books. You unpack and check before the party. Moving work between tools is the same: something that looked fine in one place may arrive missing parts or not fit the new program, so you open it and check in its new home.

questions.prompt: A table that does not fit the new door is like what?

choices.text: A file type the new program cannot handle
A file that opens perfectly in every program on every device used by everyone

questions.correct_answer: A file type the new program cannot handle

sections.title: Apply it

questions.prompt: A converted document looks fine but page 3's table is split across two pages. What kind of problem is this?

choices.text: A spelling error that was added to the table by the conversion program on purpose

questions.correct_answer: A layout shift from conversion
questions.intro: Exports can fail silently. A spreadsheet pasted as text loses its formulas, so totals no longer update. A document converted to another format may shift page breaks and tables. Special characters and accents can turn into symbols. When a deadline matters, export early, check on the device and software the audience will use, and keep the original file in its native format in case you need to try again.

questions.prompt: A deadline is tomorrow morning. When should you export?

choices.text: Early, leaving time to fix problems
